scenes.event: Planning a secret DOG reunion in the school parking lot
scenes.time: After school on a cloudy Friday afternoon
scenes.location: Empty classroom near the back of the school
scenes.description: Ethan, Tao, and Ella are huddled in a dusty back classroom, whispering and passing around a flyer they printed in secret. The cancellation of DOG has left Ethan seething, and he is determined to bring it back. Tao is uneasy but trying to stay supportive, while Ella is fully on board, her eyes bright with excitement. The tension in the room is palpable as they debate how to proceed.

characters.name: Ethan Russell
characters.description: Ethan is the rebellious heart of the group, his frustration with the school's decision to cancel DOG driving his impulsive and determined behavior. He's leaning forward on the desk, tapping a pen rhythmically, his voice low but charged with conviction.; 15-year-old male / High school student, 15 years old; Occupation: High school student; Personality: Rebellious, Frustrated, Determined, Impulsive; Values: Freedom, Friendship, Resistance to authority; Interests: Challenging rules, Planning events, Expressing anger; Experiences: School activity cancelled, Tension with school administration, Group planning, Feeling injustice, Peer pressure
characters.position: Lean forward on the desk, tapping a pen

characters.name: Tao
characters.description: Tao is the cautious one, his posture relaxed but his brow furrowed in concern; Male; Age: 15; Occupation: High school student; Personality: Thoughtful, loyal, anxious; Values: Safety, friendship, responsibility; Interests: Strategy games, reading mystery novels, planning events; Experiences: Got in trouble for organizing a school prank, helped a friend avoid a serious mistake, frequently mediates conflicts between classmates.
characters.position: Sitting with crossed legs, hands in lap

characters.name: Ella
characters.description: Ella is confident and bold, standing at the front of the room with her arms crossed; Female; Age: 15; Occupation: Student and part-time event planner for school clubs; Personality: Energetic, charismatic, determined; Values: Loyalty, creativity, justice; Interests: Organizing events, graphic design, making people laugh; Experiences: Led a successful bake sale fundraiser, organized a surprise birthday for a close friend, was a founding member of the DOG club.
characters.position: Standing at the front, arms crossed

actions.dialogue: They can't just cancel DOG without a reason. We're not going to let them erase something that brought people together. I'm doing this, and I know you both will help me.
Ethan, I get it, but what if the principal finds out? You know what happened last time we tried to push back. You could get suspended again.

actions.action: Steps closer to Ethan and raises her voice slightly
actions.dialogue: If they're going to treat us like we can't make our own choices, then we make our own rules. I'm in, no matter what. Who else is coming?
That's what I wanted to hear! We'll start with a small group, keep it low-key. If they shut it down, we just keep it going in secret. That's the point, right?
I just hope you're not doing this for the wrong reasons. I don't want to lose my chance at a scholarship over this.
You're not the only one who feels like they're losing something. This is about more than just a club. It's about standing up for what we believe in.

scenes.plot: Ethan, Tao, and Ella are planning a secret DOG reunion in the school parking lot after the administration canceled the event. Ethan is determined to challenge the school's authority, Tao is conflicted about the risks, and Ella is fully supportive of Ethan's rebellion. Their shared goal is to bring DOG back, but the plan could lead to serious consequences.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the tension between authority and freedom, and how friendship and shared values can push a group to act against the rules.
